blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Two nested n loops perform n×n operations, producing O(n²) time when each inner operation is constant.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A binary decision at each of n positions can create 2ⁿ possibilities. This exponential growth quickly outruns polynomial methods.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Big O ignores constants and lower-order terms; compare classes by input growth while acknowledging memory, workload and implementation detail.
